svg.text: VulnerableApp · 10 components · 16 data flows · 5 trust boundaries (1 inferred) · 5 internal interfaces · 46 threats

g.title: Trust boundary crossing: tb-1 External → C-04; tb-2 External → C-02; tb-3 External → C-01; tb-4 External → C-10

df-001: User browses modern UI via HTTP on port 80 (HTTP) df-001 authentication: no authentication check located in the Nginx facade configuration; routing rules exist in docker-compose templates volume; evidence: docker-compose.yml:103

df-002: User accesses legacy UI directly on port 9090 (HTTP) df-016: User requests password reset link or token via PasswordReset vulnerability endpoint (HTTP) df-002 authentication: no Spring Security configuration class located in repository source; authn_signal unknown for all routes; evidence: src/main/resources/application.properties:1 df-016 authentication: no authentication check located on password reset vulnerability handlers; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/passwordReset/PasswordResetVulnerability.java:307

df-003: User submits credentials or session token to authentication endpoints (HTTP) df-003 authentication: login handler accepts username+password parameters; session cookie returned on success; no Spring Security chain found; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/authentication/AuthLoginService.java:1, src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/sessionManagement/SessionManagementVulnerability.java:1

df-004: User requests JWT token from JWT vulnerability endpoint (HTTP) df-004 authentication: no authentication check found on JWT vulnerability handlers before token issuance; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/jwt/JWTVulnerability.java:98

df-005: Scanner POSTs findings JSON to benchmark grading endpoint (HTTP) df-005 authentication: BenchmarkController has @Profile(unsafe) and no authentication annotation or filter; no auth check in handler body; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/benchmark/controller/BenchmarkController.java:23, src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/benchmark/controller/BenchmarkController.java:38

df-006: Caller POSTs to email test endpoint to trigger SMTP delivery (HTTP) df-015: User POSTs to clearCache endpoint to reset cached HTTP responses (HTTP) df-006 authentication: EmailTestController has @Profile(unsafe) and no authentication annotation; no auth check in handler body; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/controller/EmailTestController.java:14, src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/controller/EmailTestController.java:28 df-015 authentication: CachePoisoningVulnerability handler has no authentication annotation or filter; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/cachePoisoning/CachePoisoningVulnerability.java:393
df-007: Facade reverse-proxies requests to Spring Boot backend (HTTP) df-007 authentication: internal Docker network proxy; no additional auth header added by Nginx; evidence: docker-compose.yml:97

df-008: Facade routes JSP-scoped requests to JSP container (HTTP) df-008 authentication: internal Docker network proxy; ENABLE_VULNERABLEAPP_JSP=true in docker-compose env; evidence: docker-compose.yml:111

df-009: Facade routes PHP-scoped requests to PHP container (HTTP) df-009 authentication: internal Docker network proxy; ENABLE_VULNERABLEAPP_PHP=true in docker-compose env; evidence: docker-compose.yml:112

df-010: Facade routes /llmforge prefix requests to LLMForge service (HTTP) df-010 authentication: internal Docker network proxy; ENABLE_LLMFORGE=true in docker-compose env; evidence: docker-compose.yml:113

df-011: LLMForge sends inference and embedding requests to Ollama runtime (HTTP) df-011 authentication: Ollama API has no authentication; OLLAMA_URL=http://ollama:11434 with no credentials configured; evidence: docker-compose.yml:67

df-012: Spring Boot backend reads and writes vulnerability scenario data via JDBC (JDBC) df-012 authentication: two DataSource beans: admin (schema init) and application (restricted user); H2 in-memory URL jdbc:h2:mem:testdb; evidence: src/main/resources/application.properties:4, src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/configuration/VulnerableAppConfiguration.java:104

df-013: Auth module queries and updates user credentials, sessions, and tokens via JDBC (JDBC) df-013 authentication: application DataSource user with restricted grants; repositories use JdbcTemplate or JPA; evidence: src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/authentication/AuthUserRepository.java:1, src/main/java/org/sasanlabs/service/vulnerability/sessionManagement/SessionUserRepository.java:1

df-014: Spring Boot sends test and password-reset emails to Mailpit via SMTP (SMTP) df-014 authentication: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.auth=false; MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 on mailpit; evidence: src/main/resources/application.properties:30, docker-compose.yml:87

g.text: data flow · classification colour · two heads = bidirectional
trust boundary crossed between these columns
dashed outline = zone, not itself a boundary
count = crossing threats · corner tag = guarded entry
solid = direct attack · dashed = via user
STRIDE-per-element: filled = threats found in that class
All Critical · High fills to 5 · +N = omitted High categories
counts on a node = threats per severity · ①–⑨ = attack scenario
A1 ①② = scenarios of attacker A1 · A1 at an arrowhead = its attack
badges also count scenarios that hit an asset stored there
URL fetch = requests a URL that runtime input selects or influences
RAG retrieval = retrieves documents for model context; no autonomy
Most security-critical functions always shown (at most 5), others up
to 3 labels per element: most critical first, then most severe linked
finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
Functions may go undetected: a missing label does not mean absence.
